name: Discovery Coast Atlantic Forest Reserves
description: Along Brazil's coast in Bahia and Espírito Santo, eight separate protected areas shelter about 112,000 hectares of Atlantic rainforest and sandy coastal scrub. This is some of the most species-rich rainforest on Earth, home to many plants and animals found nowhere else. It is also a rare survivor, since over 85% of the original Atlantic Forest has been cleared since the Portuguese arrived.
